name: Virtuous
description: Integrate Drupal with the Virtuous CRM fundraising platform.
project_description:
The Virtuous module for Drupal 11 provides comprehensive integration with the Virtuous CRM fundraising platform, enabling seamless data synchronization and personalized website experiences.

 ## Main Module Features 

 
 Contact Synchronization : Automatically creates and updates Drupal user accounts from Virtuous CRM contacts 
 Two-Way Integration : Optionally push changes from Drupal back to Virtuous 
 Real-Time Updates : Webhook support for instant data synchronization 
 Field Mapping : Detailed mapping between Virtuous contact fields and Drupal user fields 
 Administration Tools : Dedicated admin UI with synchronization status reporting and manual sync options 
 Secure Authentication : Uses Drupal's Key module for secure API credential storage 
 
 ## Virtuous Personalization Submodule 

 The Virtuous Personalization submodule extends the core functionality by enabling dynamic content personalization based on the Virtuous Responsive Listener:

 
 Dynamic Content : Display personalized greetings and content to visitors identified by Virtuous 
 Conditional Display : Show different content to identified vs. anonymous visitors 
 Performance Optimized : Caching and batch processing for efficient operation 
 Privacy Controls : Comprehensive privacy settings for GDPR/CCPA compliance 
 Visitor Statistics : Detailed analytics on personalization effectiveness 
 JavaScript Events API : Custom events for extending personalization functionality 
 
 This module suite is perfect for organizations seeking to create cohesive donor experiences across their Virtuous CRM and Drupal website by maintaining consistent contact data and delivering personalized content.
